chunks: And that He is the One who causes death and gives life.

key_terms.أَمَاتَ: He caused to die / He gave death

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about God causing death and life?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of *al-Hayy al-Qayyum*, affirming Allah's absolute sovereignty over both physical death and spiritual resurrection. It underscores the theological principle that all transitions in existence are not merely natural processes but direct manifestations of Divine Will, reinforcing the monotheistic understanding of causality.
